text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These tools are powerful and can produce surprising results in seconds. However, many people believe that human creativity is different. Machines can copy styles and mix ideas, but they do not have feelings or real experiences. True art often comes from emotions, memories, and personal stories. AI can support artists by offering new ideas, but it cannot replace the human imagination. In the end, the best results may come when people and machines work together.
